item.title: English Station Park-Pool Donor Emerges
item.description: The Elicker administration has found a prospective financier for the park and public pool proposed to replace English Station: the Roxanne and Henry Brandt Foundation, which expressed interest on Friday in contributing up to $10 million toward the project.
